start_here: Say to your AI: "Read my transcript file /Transcripts/day1.srt into timed words and write /Transcripts/day1.words.json." It runs read_transcript_files.py read-file on your computer.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads transcript files from the person's computer and writes words files beside them.
instructions: 1. Put the transcript file (srt, vtt, txt or json) where your computer can read it; only python 3.10 or later is needed.
2. Say "Read my transcript file /Transcripts/day1.srt into timed words"; the AI reads the tool row with tools:list and runs read_transcript_files.py read-file --file ... --out ....
3. Read the last line {"result": {words_json, timing, segments, words, duration}}: timing says whether times are per word, per segment or none.

4. For a whole drive use pick_transcript_files.py then read-files; for a channel download use caption_transcripts.py; for videos with no captions use tool:hear-a-link; check quotes with find_whisper_quotes.py.
